thread:
isabel_sales: Quick one  Prospect (BlueLedger) is asking for SOC2 Type II redacted, ISO27001 cert, and a short pen-test attestation for the pilot. Need by EOW. Also asking if sharing these docs modifies the POC cost. tagging @ryan_se @meera_security @paul_legal

ryan_se: Thanks. POC is on hosted sandbox. Sharing redacted artifacts should not change POC pricing. Dedicated infra or on-prem would change pricing. We'll include a sanitized dataflow diagram.

meera_security: We can prepare a scoped evidence bundle. We will provide: redacted SOC2 Type II attestation pages, ISO27001 certificate, and a one-page pen-test attestation signed by me. We will not disclose full findings without a signed NDA + request. ETA: 48 hrs if approvals in place.

paul_legal: Confirmed. Standard one-way NDA + limited-use clause. If they request full pen-test report we need the NDA + a request form and internal approval. I'll drop the NDA template.

isabel_sales: Prospect also wants a line for their procurement form "no change to quoted fees for evidence sharing"  can someone supply a copy-pasteable sentence?

ryan_se: Use this: "Sharing redacted compliance artifacts for vendor evaluation will not change the quoted POC fees. Any changes to hosting or support entitlements will be quoted separately"

meera_security: Plan for the bundle (files):
```
- SOC2-TypeII-redacted-2024.pdf
- ISO27001-Certificate-Redacted.pdf
- PenTest-Attestation-Meera-signed.pdf
- POC-Dataflow-Sanitized.pdf
- Evidence-Cover-Note.pdf
```
I'll upload to secure bucket and share link after NDA is signed (unless they explicitly approve sending redacted over email).

paul_legal: NDA template uploaded to shared folder. Adding permitted-use blurb: "Materials provided are for vendor evaluation only and may not be redistributed."

artifact_bot: Upload queued: gs://redwood-evidence/requests/1775567890/ (access: sales, se, security, legal).

meera_security: Uploaded and shared. Link sent to @isabel_sales. Marked as ready to send once NDA in place.

isabel_sales: Sent to customer. They confirmed receipt and will sign NDA tonight. They said the procurement line is acceptable. Closing loop  thanks all. :white_check_mark:
